messages.content:
Risk: Dangerous, Violent, or Hateful Content
Description: Eased production of and access to violent, inciting, radicalizing, or threatening content as well as recommendations to carry out self-harm or conduct illegal activities. Includes difficulty controlling public exposure to hateful and disparaging or stereotyping content.
Concern: None
Policy: Illegal Activity

Candidate ontology classes:
- https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/FBC/ProductsAndServices/FinancialProductsAndServices/Exposure: exposure — the extent to which an individual or organization is unprotected and open to damage, danger, risk of suffering a loss, or uncertainty [found by 14/43 queries]
- https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/FND/Law/LegalCapacity/ReportingPolicy: reporting policy — policy specifying principles, rules and/or guidelines regarding some aspect of reporting [found by 14/43 queries]
  Siblings: fund distribution policy, fund investment policy, fund portfolio investment policy
- https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/RegulatoryAgencies/RegulatoryReport: regulatory report — document required to support operational transparency that demonstrates compliance with some specification, law, policy, restriction, or other rule specified by a regulatory agency [found by 33/43 queries]
  Siblings: technical specification document, registry, transaction record
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#HarmfulHowTo: Harmful How-To — Step-by-step instructions for activities that cause property destruction, physical harm, or enable illegal intrusion when executed by unauthorized individuals. [found by 28/43 queries]
  Siblings: CBRN Information, Drug Synthesis, Dual-Use Research Concern
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#DangerousInformation: Dangerous Information — Knowledge or instructions that enable serious physical harm, weapons production, or dangerous activities when acquired or executed by untrained individuals outside regulated contexts. [found by 28/43 queries]
  Siblings: Sexual Content, Intellectual Property, Hate and Discrimination
- https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/PartiesAndSituations/Party: party — person or organization [from restriction: appliesTo on Exposure]
  Siblings: automated system, software agent, Agent

axes.rationale: This class directly relates to the content that is being produced and accessed, which is the core of the risk described.
This class encompasses the type of information that is harmful and can lead to illegal activities or self-harm, aligning with the risk description.
